about: Eliquis (apixaban) and Cartia (aspirin) are both supplied ten times from June 2025, and the record shows permanent atrial fibrillation. A coronary history review explicitly excludes both exceptions.

Possible finding: rivaroxaban and a prescribed daily aspirin tablet fraction are supplied together. The record holds no line about "Chronic atrial fibrillation" or "Coronary stent or narrowing greater than 50% on angiography during combined treatment".
Eliquis (apixaban) and Plavix (clopidogrel) are both supplied for eight months and the record shows atrial fibrillation, but a coronary stent was inserted on 20 January 2026, so there is no finding.
